name: How long does a garage conversion project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage conversion project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a garage conversion varies depending on the project's complexity and the local permitting process. Generally, design and permitting can take several weeks to a few months. Construction itself for a standard conversion might range from 8 to 16 weeks, though larger or more complex projects could take longer. Delays can occur due to inspections or material availability.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion project typically takes 8 to 16 weeks for construction, after an initial period for design and permitting.
